title: predictive-load-shedder-with-proactive-circuit-reset-and-eviction-prioritization
author: Alyssa Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed recurring tail SLO skews in multi-tenant regions where transient KV-cache thrashing and stuck worker circuits cause cascading latency spikes. This PR implements a predictive load-shedding component that uses short-window request telemetry (p50/p95 slope, prefix hit ratio, inflight queue depth) to pre-emptively shed low-priority requests before traditional circuit breakers trip, plus a proactive circuit reset scheduler that reduces islanded-worker duration. The goal is graceful degradation with fewer hard failures and faster recovery; this is a hotfix intended for immediate rollout to affected regions.

Changes (high level): added a new predictive_shedder module, a reset_scheduler for proactive circuit resets, and an eviction-priority recalibration in the request router. Also added observability hooks and a minimal rollout script for controlled canary. Key behavior:
- predictive_shedder: runs a lightweight heuristics model (exponential smoothing + simple logistic priority score) that flags shards likely to miss SLOs within the next 3s window and applies configurable pre-shed policies.
- reset_scheduler: schedules soft resets (graceful worker recycle) when a worker shows stuck KV state or sustained high-latency tail for >2x expected recovery time.
- eviction-prioritizer: recomputes per-tenant eviction score using realtime priority + age + recent-shedding-count to avoid starving long-running critical workloads.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of predictive_shedder with config flags and defaults
- [x] Reset scheduler with opt-in annotation for Dedicated pools
- [x] Router integration and API surface for per-route priority
- [x] Unit tests for scoring, expiry and reset timers
- [x] Integration test in perf-canary harness (staged)
- [x] Observability: new metrics and tracing spans
- [x] Documentation: runtime operational notes and rollout steps

Testing & CI: Initial CI run failed on linter (unused import in reset_scheduler). Fixed and re-ran; full pipeline passed. Integration perf-canary run shows tail P99 improved ~18% during synthetic KV thrash test while cost delta was <2% due to targeted shedding. See attached perf graphs in Linear ENG-1987. Rationale for approach: previous reactive circuit breakers allowed SLOs to be violated repeatedly while waiting for the breaker threshold; predictive pre-shedding reduces exposure window and gives the reset scheduler time to recover healthy workers without full region failovers.

Rollout plan:
1) Deploy to staging and perf-canary (automated) — included in this PR's test run
2) Canary to region-us-west-2 with 5% traffic using hotpatch script scripts/rollout/hotpatch.sh
3) Monitor shed_rate_by_tenant, p99_latency, circuit_reset_count; if p99 regresses >5% stop and revert
4) Gradually increase to 25% then 100% over 6 hours if stable

Operational knobs (config/policy):
- predictive_window_ms: 3000
- pre_shed_threshold: 0.65 (score)
- reset_grace_ms: 12000
- eviction_weightings: [priority:0.5, age:0.3, past_shed_count:0.2]

Risk & mitigations: Overly aggressive shedding could impact important low-volume workloads. Mitigations: 1) Default policies are conservative; 2) Route-level opt-out and per-tenant priority pins; 3) Immediate rollback via hotpatch script; 4) observability alerting on any rise in error-rate or retry storms.

Files changed (summary): see files_changed field. Small illustrative snippet (predictive score): `score = sigmoid( 1.2 * slope_p95 + 0.8 * (1 - prefix_hit_ratio) + 0.6 * (queue_depth / max_q) )` — used only in scoring, not a trained model.

Related: ENG-1987 (telemetry-first shedding design), ENG-2190 (circuit reset experiments), SUP-8741 (customer incident that motivated hotpatch).

review_comments: Mateo Rivera: Can you explain why we chose 3s predictive window vs 1s or 5s? I worry about oscillation at shorter windows.
Alyssa Chen: We did an ablation in ENG-1987; 3s balanced prediction utility vs false positives on our traffic. Logs added to docs with tuning guidance.
Jordan Patel: Reset scheduler doing soft restarts — what's the expected failure mode? Could this trigger more evictions?
Alyssa Chen: Soft restart drains connections and preserves KV checkpoints. We also gate resets with a cooldown per-worker to avoid thrash (configurable reset_backoff_ms).
Sofia Kravitz: Observability looks good but add per-tenant shed_rate metric and a tracing span for predictive decision path.
Alyssa Chen: Added shed_rate_by_tenant metric and spans (see docs). Added a unit test for metric emission.
release_notes: Hotfix: Introduce predictive load-shedder + proactive circuit reset to reduce tail SLO violations during KV thrash. Admins can tune predictive_window_ms, pre_shed_threshold and reset_grace_ms. See docs/operational/predictive_shedding.md for details.
